# Synthetic BCF 2.1 fixture

`review.bcfzip` contains two topics. One has perspective and orthographic viewpoints, clipping,
visibility exceptions and components matched by IFC GlobalId or Revit UniqueId. The other refers
to an unavailable viewpoint. The archive contains synthetic issue data and no model geometry.

The version, markup and viewpoint XML were validated against the
[buildingSMART BCF 2.1 schemas](https://github.com/buildingSMART/BCF-XML/tree/v2.1/Schemas).
